records.generatedCopy: Gemini 4 Argon can run background long-decode jobs for up to 24 hours, but a longer runway also creates new cost, reconnect, and completeness risks. This checklist shows how to route only suitable workloads, cap spend per accepted artifact, resume streams from saved event IDs, and reject truncated or duplicated output before rollout. Vendor performance claims are kept separate from verified API behavior.
